dedupe_keys.name: openits open traffic data sharing platform china

description: OpenITS OpenData is a Chinese platform for sharing multi-source traffic big data for transport research. It builds a visual platform for data exchange, common data structures and standards for traffic data of different levels and types, and links between datasets, and it also shares traffic models and tools as open source. The listed collections are expressway and urban expressway data, urban road data, individual travel data, detector data and a dataset of generated individual origin-destination sequences. It is run by the OpenITS alliance, with co-conveners from Wuhan University of Technology, Tsinghua University, Sun Yat-sen University and Zhejiang University. Coverage is national (China) in scope, with datasets from particular cities and roads. Alliance members upload data in the common format, and after a quality review the data are opened for download by other members. Caveats: downloads are limited to alliance members, the pages are in Chinese, and dataset licences are not stated on the page read. The data support traffic flow and speed modelling, calibration of network models and travel demand studies. It complements the Korean and Japanese traffic count data catalogued here.
